requirements.title: A block-data specification part is limited to the listed definition, attribute, association, and declaration statements

requirements.title: An initially defined named common block requires all storage units in its storage sequence to be specified
requirements.source: 14.3 p2 first sentence; J3/24-007, 18 December 2023 PDF p322.
requirements.definition: After any object in a named common block is initially defined, all storage units in that common block storage sequence shall be specified, even storage units not initially defined.

Negative missing-storage source control has no required diagnostic from this prose rule alone.
